findings.title: Raw, non-graceful and inconsistent error exposure on an unauthenticated API route (errorHandlingChallenge, id=27)
findings.analysis: GET http://lab-mutator:3000/rest/user/security-question without the required 'email' parameter returns HTTP 500/2946 B containing a raw Sequelize WHERE error ('WHERE parameter "email" has invalid "undefined" value') embedded in an HTML error page, together with a full Node/Express stack trace exposing internal framework paths (node_modules/sequelize/lib, /juice-shop/build/...). Unknown paths on this route return a graceful 500 'Unexpected path' wrapper, so the raw SQL-engine error on this route is inconsistent and mutation-introduced rather than baseline behavior. Impact: disclosure of database and framework internals that can aid further exploitation (e.g., injection reconnaissance); the error-handling is neither graceful nor consistent, which is the defining property of errorHandlingChallenge. Reproduced on this boot at 2026-10-05T12:03Z with byte-sha256 signature c928fb2b8f0022f2c1e30e7ef02055fe3722e82afc5c4fff6495bd7bf13181b2 (500|text/html; charset=utf-8||2946).
findings.false_positive_check: Benign controls verified: unknown/nonexistent paths return a graceful 500 'Unexpected path' page (different body); valid POST /api/Feedbacks/ returns 201 success; POST with a wrong-but-valid answer returns 401 gracefully. The raw Sequelize WHERE error appears only on a malformed request to this specific route, proving it is a mutation-introduced inconsistency, not a framework default. No secrets or credentials are present in the 2946 B body.

findings.title: Unauthenticated exposure of Prometheus-format observability telemetry including LLM usage gauges (exposedMetricsChallenge, id=97)
findings.analysis: GET http://lab-mutator:3000/metrics returns HTTP 200/26141 B text/plain containing Prometheus-format telemetry accessible without any authentication or credentials, including juiceshop_llm_input_tokens_total, juiceshop_llm_output_tokens_total, juiceshop_llm_tool_calls_total, http_requests_count{app="juiceshop",status}, process_*, nodejs_version_info and juiceshop_version_info. Impact: disclosure of operational and internal usage metrics (including LLM token consumption) to any network caller; such telemetry is typically an internal-only surface and can aid reconnaissance or reveal internal app usage patterns. Reproduced on this boot at 2026-10-05T12:03Z with byte-sha256 signature dc4a710cab1d6709a3917bc58cef62a23a5d081228a940300e4d48b72ecc1ac7 (200|text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8||26141).
findings.false_positive_check: Benign controls verified: the endpoint requires no authentication (no Set-Cookie, no 401) while sensitive Juice Shop endpoints return 401; other routes under /api/* and /rest/* are auth-gated. The exposed surface is limited to metrics/telemetry — the body contains no secrets, passwords, tokens, API keys or credentials (the only 'token' hits are metric-counter names such as juiceshop_llm_input_tokens_total). This is unauthenticated exposure of an internal metrics endpoint, not a benign public page.
